ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionIn your role you will support the organization in achieving a well governed data lake that ensures data availability, common understanding of business terms, impeccable data quality, traceable and controlled data in line with regulations. In other words, an ambitious implementation based on leading technology.Your day to dayEven if youll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our offices garden, your day will be quite similar when comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:Closely collaborate with stakeholders to:Together with relevant stakeholders from business areas (like Financial Insights, Direct Products, Service and Operations, KYC), you contribute to understanding and clarifying the requirementsDraw up conceptual and logical data models (different types) - you are a sparring partner for engineers for the translation of these models to the physical modelCreate detailed specifications that DevOps engineers will use to source and structure data into the Data LakeCreate testing scenarios and actively participate in functional testingSafeguarding the consistency and quality of data: create requirements on data quality, data lineage, data privacy, data security, and other relevant aspects of data by recording the data definitions in the data dictionary and maintaining them as part of metadata managementAlign with the architects on the data lake design and ensure the implementation of the new solution is done according to the data lake target architectureContinuously take initiative to improve the way of working and the collaboration within your team and stakeholders. Actively participating in gathering the requirements for automation of our software processesWhat youll bring to the team Experience:Strong conceptual and analytical skillsExperience with banking industry or financial institutions is a plusKnowledge of and experience within the Credit Risk and Credit Risk modelling areas in the financial industry is nice to haveHands-on experience working with SQL and databases and/or data warehouses is expectedKnowledge of and experience in data management, data modelling (dimensional) and data warehouse technology is a plusFinance, Credit Risk, Regulatory processes and Operational Risk know-how is a plusHands-on experience with data quality, data lineage, data security, data privacy, data lifecycle management, data issue remediation and other data-governance practices is a plusDetailed oriented, take it on and make it happen attitude, drive to help others succeed and a knack for always being a step aheadExcellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing, to be able to align with various stakeholders on different levelsExperience in requirements gathering and writing technical and functional specificationsExperience with Agile methodologiesTech stack/ knowledge:Mandatory: ability to use SQL for medium complexity queries, good understanding of data base conceptsNice have: understanding and ability to apply data modeling concepts and techniquesForeign languages: English (advanced)Education: nice to have Bachelors Degree (or higher) in an IT related fieldIf you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
